chunks: The qunut is in the second rakʿah before the rukuʿ, then in the fourth, then in the sixth, then in the eighth, then in the tenth.

key_terms.اَلثَّانِيَةِ: The second rakʿah, the first place mentioned for qunut here
key_terms.اَلرَّكْعَةِ: A rakʿah; a unit of the prayer
key_terms.اَلرُّكُوعِ: Rukuʿ; the bowing position in prayer
key_terms.اَلْقُنُوتَ: Qunut; the supplication recited in the standing position of salat

ai.seo_question: In which rakʿahs is qunut recited in the prayer for eclipses and similar events?
ai.summary: This hadith states the placement of qunut within the prayer under discussion, specifying that it is performed before rukuʿ in the second rakʿah and then repeated in every even-numbered rakʿah up to the tenth. It serves as a jurisprudential report describing the prescribed pattern of devotional supplication in this form of salat.
